$comment: Which sound a notification makes, for every surface. Web imports this file; iOS (AlertSound.swift) and Android (AlertSound.kt) mirror it, and their unit tests read it to catch drift. Rules, first match wins: a silent scope makes no sound; the patient audience gets patient_sound; an urgent kind is urgent; an urgent entity type is urgent unless its kind is calm (a code blue stand-down is info); an attention entity type is attention; a calm kind is calm; anything else is default_sound. Urgent is for critical values and emergency codes only.
